about: Kratos' controls expressed as Elden Ring action bits (CSChrActionRequestModule), so keyboard, XInput and DualSense all work without us touching device drivers. 'blocks' are ER actions masked (disabled_action_inputs) while the binding fires.

rows.label: Light attack
rows.purpose: ER plays the weapon's own light chain; we observe the swing to run Ragnarök's rules (rage, stun, sfx).

rows.label: Block / parry window
rows.purpose: Guardian Shield. A guard that starts just before a hit is a perfect parry (rules layer).

rows.label: Dodge
rows.purpose: ER's roll / backstep as Kratos' dodge.

rows.label: Aim (axe / spear)
rows.purpose: Hold to aim the throw reticle; masks the weapon-art action.

rows.label: Throw
rows.purpose: While aiming: throw the Leviathan Axe or Draupnir Spear.

rows.label: Recall / detonate
rows.purpose: Recall the thrown axe; detonate thrown spears. This is Elden Ring's interact button (Triangle / Y on a pad), so it is only taken over while a throw is out and passes through to the game otherwise.

rows.label: Swap weapon
rows.purpose: ER cycles right-hand slots 1-3: Axe, Blades, Spear.

rows.label: Stow / draw shield
rows.purpose: ER cycles the left-hand slot: Guardian Shield or empty.

rows.label: Spartan Rage
rows.purpose: Activate Rage when the meter is full.

rows.label: Finisher
rows.purpose: When a stunned enemy is in reach, R3 executes it; otherwise R3 stays ER lock-on.

rows.label: Light runic attack
rows.purpose: D-pad up on pad. Masks ER spell switching.

rows.label: Heavy runic attack
rows.purpose: D-pad down on pad. Masks ER item switching.
